definition: The particular expression — calm, pleasant, utterly empty of authentic emotion — worn by Palladian Group representatives, negotiators, and fixers during high-stakes meetings. Broadly used to describe any person performing corponation-coached emotional neutrality.
origin: Street satirical slang, derived from Palladian Group's reputation for affectless corporate diplomacy
usage: Street samurai, fixers, anyone who has sat across from a corponation negotiator
example: The moment she put on the Palladian smile, everyone in the room knew the deal was dead and they just hadn't been told yet.
